defect: Case analysis forces the functional clock port low instead of constraining the test-mode select pin.
rationale: The switch selects test_clk only when test_mode_i is asserted. Setting func_clk_i to zero disables the normal operating clock and leaves the functional scenario falsely clean; case analysis belongs on test_mode_i for a functional-mode analysis.

mutation.description: Applied set_case_analysis to the functional clock port rather than the mode select controlling the test clock.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Forcing the functional clock port to zero suppresses the actual clock used by the register when test_mode_i is low; a data-mode strap should be constrained instead of the clock signal.
